source_kind: Metamon reconstructed replay teams; observed full human sets are NOT asserted
label: Individual simulated battle outcome conditional on declared policies and rules; not exact pair win rate
seed_policy: Keep each consecutive pair group on the same machine. Same engine seed for both sides within each root. Native timed search remains nondeterministic.
pilot_censor_policy: Continue only on recognized zero-visit Foul Play crash. Preserve logs, assign null outcome and do not retry. Other errors stop the batch.
test_policy: Hold out test outcomes until model and candidate selection protocol are fixed.
sampling: 1000 new train pairs and the 10 remaining validation pairs, excluding all pairs in v1-v4; both orientations; root seed 307.
scope: User-authorized additional development collection after core final evaluation. Does not change the frozen core model or supply a new independent final test.
